name: iphone-use
description: Observe and operate a connected physical iPhone with the iPhone-use CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Eyes and hands for agents on a real iPhone.
interface.longDescription: Discover and control iPhone apps through standard screenshot/HID or Runner mode. Requires the iPhone-use CLI and supported Apple toolchain; Runner additionally requires development signing.
defaultPrompt: Open Settings on my iPhone, navigate to General, verify the screen, then disconnect.
